record.question: Choose the option which is closest in meaning to penitent.
record.explanation: Answer B: remorseful. “Penitent” means feeling or showing regret for wrongdoing; “remorseful” is closest. Independent check: “Penitent” means feeling or expressing sorrow for wrongdoing; “remorseful” is the closest synonym. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/penitent; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/penitent. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
